    for expected_idx, cwr in enumerate(combinations_with_replacement(pool, r)):

# p'(2) = 12 - 16 - 17 = -21
print(f'p_eval(p_deriv, 2) = {mi.polynomial_eval(mi.polynomial_derivative([1, -4, -17, 60]), 2)}')
print(f'Expected: -21')

# Test R10: batched, convolve, factor, matmul, numeric_range, sieve, transpose

print(f'batched([1,2,3,4,5], 2) = {list(mi.batched([1,2,3,4,5], 2))}')
